name: Erik Solberg
bio:
Erik Solberg is a rising star in the Oslo legal scene, specializing in contract law and intellectual property, particularly within the sports and entertainment sectors. Fresh out of his postgraduate studies at the University of Oslo, he quickly made a name for himself by successfully representing several high-profile athletes in endorsement deals and contract negotiations. Erik’s empathetic nature often leads him to take on pro bono cases, reflecting his strong moral compass, but this is balanced by a reckless streak that occasionally manifests in impulsive decisions and a tendency to be overprotective of his clients. He has a deep appreciation for the finer things in life, cultivated through his privileged upbringing, and enjoys pursuing hobbies like polo, sailing, and art collecting in his free time.

Despite not being a driver himself, Erik's connection to motorsport stems from his family's long-standing sponsorship of a local rally team. He’s become increasingly involved in handling the legal affairs of several young drivers and racing teams, navigating the complex world of sponsorship agreements, driver contracts, and image rights. A racing driver might cross paths with Erik when seeking legal representation for contract negotiations, sponsorship deals, or intellectual property protection related to their brand or image.
